description.value: The Cordova Room is an intimate whiskey and cocktail bar tucked into the heart of Gastown, featuring dark green walls, warm wood, and golden accents. It specializes in scratch-made cocktails and a curated selection of rare single malts, paired with refined small bites. Located on Carrall Street in one of Vancouver's most historically rich and cycle-friendly neighbourhoods, it makes a distinctive evening stop for touring cyclists.
